issues.summary: Compose responses could replace the schema contract with prose; Compose now requires fenced schema-valid JSON.
Leaving motion used an ease-in curve; Skill sources now use the component-aligned short strong ease-out curve.
References and the example Blueprint used unpublished pseudo primitive IDs; Product Moment tables and fixtures now use published IDs.
Public motion-grammar uses the strong ease-out leave curve and all component foundation IDs resolve to published primitives.
Initial fresh-run isolation leaked global skills through HOME; final runs isolate HOME and CODEX_HOME.
The first negative-trigger guard forced Skill use; the final guard preserves natural trigger selection.
Motion Director naming was removed from Skill metadata, contract, validation messages, and script paths.
